correctness.rationale: Each SL2(Fp) residue A has p³ determinant-one lifts forming the affine hyperplane with normal (adj A)^T. Character orthogonality kills the entire fiber unless barM is proportional to this normal. Primitive rank-one barM and nonsquare det barM thus vanish; primitive invertible square determinant gives two lifts of A indexed t=±sqrt(det barM), contributing two p²-th roots which cannot cancel for odd p. Imprimitive M=pN reduces to finite-field SL2 character sums: rank0 nonzero, rank1 -p, rank2 p times a Kloosterman sum of p-1 pth roots. The latter cannot vanish because zero integer-coefficient sum of primitive pth roots requires total coefficient count divisible by p. Half of invertible reductions have square determinant; p⁴ lifts per reduction yield rank. Independently counted all 648 determinant-one matrices at p3 and all 6561 frequencies with exact cyclotomic coefficient divisibility: rank 2025, nullity 4536.
